items.title: Father Al Lewis Interview, 1972-02-21
items.q: He gave Shirley a lift too. I can't call his name. I don't know.

ctx.x: What does he do? What did he get money for?

Well, different funds. He come in there to buy instruments for the symphony, you know, when he's about to go out of business. What's his name? He gave Shirley a lift too. I can't call his name. I don't know. It could be Stern. Yeah, Edgar B. Stern. Edgar B. Stern came in there to buy instruments in Groomwolf, and he heard me play, and he was teasing me one day, he'd say, well I'll teach you how to play the guitar. If you buy me a drink, I'd say okay. I did. So, 3521 Diffin Street, well they started to send in…
What about anybody in your family? Did they help you? Did you have any musicians in your family at all?
